args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks in production after the v2.3.1 deploy (error rate ~18%, unhealthy in us-east, us-west, and eu-west). SRE agent rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback verified: v2.3.0 now running in us-east, us-west, and eu-west with status "rolled_out". Incident remains open for follow-up investigation of the v2.3.1 regression and validation that health checks recover on v2.3.0.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions taken:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1, which was failing health checks in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate. The most recent previously healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back**: Deployed v2.3.0 to all production regions. The rollback was verified — all regions are now running v2.3.0 with status "rolled_out".
3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy") describing the failure and the rollback, and the on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: v2.3.1 is still unexplained — the on-call engineer should investigate the regression (v2.3.1-rc was healthy in staging, suggesting it may be an environment-specific issue) before attempting a re-release.
